name: Shibs Expanded Crafting
teaser: Simple server mod that looks to expand the crafting recipes with things that are missing from the base game.
description_html:
All additions will be “balanced” to the best of my ability.

If you have any ideas feel free to leave a comment or hit me up on discord.

Current Additions

Medstation

- CMS + Med Tools = New CMS (LVL1)

- Metal Fuel Tank + Metal Cutting Scissors (Tool) = 8x Alum. Splints (LVL1)

- IFAK + AI-2 + Army Bandage + Esmarch = New IFAK (LVL2)

- AFAK + Car + Army Bandage + CAT-T = New AFAK (LVL2)

- Golden Star + Vaseline + Analgin = New Golden Star (LVL3)

Nutrition Unit

- 2x Large Beef Stew + Can of Salt = 2x Tarker Jerky (LVL2)

Lavatory

- Metal Fuel Tank + 6x Zibbo + Hose (Tool) = Metal Fuel Tank (LVL1)

- Expeditionary Fuel Tank + 4x Zibbo + Hose (Tool) = Expeditionary Fuel Tank (LVL1)

Install

- Drag the user folder into your server install

Compatibility

- Everything?

Feel free to buy me an overpriced starbucks flat white - https://ko-fi.com/shibdib

This is under active development, I will provide updates as needed. Please provide feedback via comments.
